messages:
Jess (support): FYI multiple customers pinging about huge p95/p99 regressions since ~17:30 UTC, endpoints show long ingress queues and lots of requests stuck in worker_wait. Observed across regions :frowning:
Anna (SRE): Can you paste example request ids and affected routes? need to check queue depth & worker cpu/idx.
Jess (support): req ids: r-8a3f, r-9b22, r-c1d4. Affected: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Customers report 3-10x slower p95.
Lee (runtime): grabbing traces now. Preliminary: one worker pool (s-12) at 100% GPU utilization + thread saturation on the inference threads. Async queue length jumping to 50-200 requests.
Miguel (oncall): Any recent deploys? @deploy-bot did we have a rollout to runtime in past hour?
deploy-bot: deploy/rollout: runtime-service v2026.03.17-7 started by lee at 17:12 UTC; canary: 3 -> 25% at 17:14 -> 100% at 17:22 UTC.
Anna (SRE): That matches timing. Possible regression in batching logic or a change in backoff path. Check: kernel selection change or new batching window config.
Lee (runtime): Pulling logs: see repeated WARN in runtime: "batcher: queue timeout exceeded, leaving requests in pending" and also increased KV cache evictions. Snip:

```
[17:21:45] WARN batcher: queue timeout exceeded for batch_id=0x7f3a
[17:21:45] ERROR executor: failed to schedule inference task: worker_pool=gnn-s-12 reason=thread_busy
```
Anna (SRE): Ok. Temp mitigation: reduce max_concurrency on pool s-12 to 8 (from 16) and increase overflow pool capacity. Also enable early-reject throttle for routes /v1/generate to shed load.
Miguel (oncall): I can patch the pool config now. Will run a conservative cap and spin up extra workers.
Lee (runtime): Commands:
```
# reduce concurrency
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://internal-api/runtime/pools/s-12/config -d '{"max_concurrency":8}'
# scale overflow
kubectl scale deploy runtime-overflow --replicas=6 -n runtime
```
Jess (support): Let me warn affected customers that we're applying mitigations and will follow up with repro steps.
Anna (SRE): Also rolling back kernel selector change from v2026.03.17-7 as a precaution. @deploy-bot please rollback to v2026.03.16-9 on runtime-service.
deploy-bot: rollback requested: runtime-service -> v2026.03.16-9. Starting at 17:36 UTC.
Lee (runtime): After cap + overflow + rollback we see queue depth drop from ~180 -> ~20 and p95 back to baseline within ~3m. GPU util on s-12 dropped to 72% and thread_wait gone.
Miguel (oncall): Monitoring for regressions; keeping overflow up and cap in place until postmortem. I'll also disable the aggressive batching window flag (batch_window_ms=8 -> 4) that shipped in the rollout.
Anna (SRE): Great. Next steps: collect traces for the failed batch paths, run a controlled canary of the batching change in a lab, and add a safety circuit to prevent full-saturation when KV cache misses spike.
Jess (support): Messaging customers now. ETA for detailed follow-up and RCA: EOD. :thumbsup:
Anna (SRE): Filing incident ticket and assigning postmortem. I'll include exact metrics (queue length, p95/p99, deploy id, config diffs). Thanks everyone.
